description: A repeat loop runs its body a counted number of times
A balance compounds once a year for a counted number of years
code:
balance = 100
years = 2
repeat years:
    balance = balance * 1.5
balance

description: A repeat count is read once even when the body grows what it reads
code:
queue = [1, 2]
size = queue.length
repeat size:
    queue.push(0)
[queue.length, size]

description: A fractional count truncates and a negative count runs nothing
code:
n = 0
repeat 3.7: n = n + 1
repeat 2 - 5: n = n + 100
n

description: A function accumulates a local across the iterations of a repeat loop
code:
def power(base, exponent):
    result = 1
    repeat exponent:
        result = result * base
    return result
[power(2, 10), power(5, 0)]

description: A constructor builds a counted number of parts
code:
class Wheel(car):
    this.car = car
class Car(wheels):
    repeat wheels:
        Wheel(this)
bike = Car(2)
trike = Car(3)
Wheel.filter(w -> w.car == trike).length

description: A method returns from inside a repeat loop
Nested repeat loops fill a grid of cells
code:
class Cell(row, col):
    this.row = row
    this.col = col
row = 0
repeat 2:
    col = 0
    repeat 3:
        Cell(row, col)
        col = col + 1
    row = row + 1
Cell.map(c -> c.row * 10 + c.col)

description: A thrown value rolls back every iteration of a repeat loop
code:
class Box
filled = 0
try:
    repeat 3:
        Box()
        filled = filled + 1
        if filled == 2:
            throw "FULL"
catch error:
    reason = error
[reason, Box.length, filled]

description: A repeat loop inside a standing rule runs again when the rule runs
code:
class Meter
meter = Meter()
meter.ticks = 2
meter.total = 0
if meter.ticks > 0:
    repeat meter.ticks: meter.total = meter.total + 1
meter.ticks = 3
meter.total

description: A count above the bound raises before the first iteration
code:
ran = 0
try:
    repeat 100001: ran = ran + 1
catch error:
    problem = error
[problem, ran]

description: Repeat stays an ordinary name beside repeat loops
code:
repeat = 3
n = 0
repeat repeat: n = n + repeat
["ab".repeat(2), n]
